tooltip.rail_beetle.engine.steam_drive: Burn fuel and water; softens grade and consist penalties by 30%.
tooltip.rail_beetle.engine.flux_traction: Consumes 256 FE/work; accelerates loaded or high-speed runs 30% faster.
tooltip.rail_beetle.engine.source_impell: Consumes 1 Source/work; survey work costs 30% less.
tooltip.rail_beetle.engine.lifeforce_ram: Consumes 1 mB/work; motion above 4 blocks/s costs 30% less.
tooltip.rail_beetle.engine.soul_combusto: Consumes 1 soul per 20 work and reduces all work by 30%.
tooltip.rail_beetle.engine.spirit_warpin: Consumes 1 spirit per 6,000 work; construction costs 30% less.
tooltip.rail_beetle.install_stopped: Install or remove only while stopped with brakes applied.
tooltip.rail_beetle.module.adhesion_sand: Full uphill speed solo; 75% with a consist.
Full uphill speed through the rated consist.
tooltip.rail_beetle.module.reinforced_dr: Raises hauling capacity from 2 to 6 trailing carts.
Raises hauling capacity to 12 trailing carts.
tooltip.rail_beetle.module.telescopic_su: Raises proposed route range from 64 to 128 rails.
Raises proposed route range to 192 rails.
tooltip.rail_beetle.module.dispatch_rece: Enables Dispatch Remote control within 128 blocks.
Controls any loaded Beetle in the same dimension; never loads chunks.
tooltip.rail_beetle.module.trestle_erect: Builds bottom-up supports 12 deep across gaps 5 rails wide.
Builds bottom-up supports 32 deep across gaps 12 rails wide.
tooltip.rail_beetle.module.caged_searchl: Toggleable dynamic light; one work per lit second.
tooltip.rail_beetle.remote.unbound: Unbound — use on a Beetle with a Dispatch Receiver.
screen.rail_beetle.stop: Stop moving. Your active route stays saved.
screen.rail_beetle.reverse: Reverse slowly. This clears any active route.
screen.rail_beetle.half: Drive forward at 2 blocks per second.
screen.rail_beetle.normal: Drive forward at 4 blocks per second.
screen.rail_beetle.double: Drive forward at 8 blocks per second. Requires High-Speed Governor I.
screen.rail_beetle.triple: Drive forward at 12 blocks per second. Requires High-Speed Governor II.
screen.rail_beetle.searchlight: Turn the Caged Searchlight on or off. Requires a Caged Searchlight module.
screen.rail_beetle.brake.tooltip: ON locks the Beetle in place. AUTO lets it brake when needed. Turn it ON before changing machinery.
screen.rail_beetle.neutral.tooltip: Free-roll clears the active route, releases the brake, and lets another vehicle push or tow the Beetle.
